Reason: Zero server cost, highly requested for personal finance and official documents. Easy to implement via local PDF engines.

Reason: Essential baseline tool. Needs target size preset (e.g. <5MB, <2MB) to maximize user satisfaction.

Problem: Combining separate scanned sheets into a single submission
Reason: Fundamental core utility. Critical for students and office workers.

Problem: Marking documents 'CONFIDENTIAL' or 'COPY' for legal/tender submissions
Reason: Useful for freelancers and office workers; moderate demand, easy local rendering.

Problem: Numbering large packets for court/thesis/official submission
Reason: Niche business utility. Strong Pro paywall candidate without high development burden.

Reason: High demand but crowded market (Google Files dominates). Good for retention if kept clean and privacy-focused.

Problem: Extract text from receipt/page without typing
